newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova to issue special insurance bonds.
newsitem.headline: Moldova to issue special insurance bonds.

text.p: Moldova's Finance Ministry plans to issue special government bonds to rebuild private insurance savings consumed by hyperinflation.
The ministry will issue a total of six million lei of bonds by the end of the year, transferring the proceeds to the state insurance company ASITO, a finance ministry official said.
"This money will be transferred to ASITO to partially index insurance deposits of private persons consumed by hyperinflation since 1992," he told Reuters.

Annual inflation soared to over 2,000 percent in 1992 and 1993. The rate of increase in prices slowed to 105 percent in 1994 and 23.8 percent in 1995, and inflation is expected to slow further to 17 percent this year and 10 percent in 1997.
The bonds will pay annual interest of 15 percent, but will be sold at auction, so the yield may be higher if the bonds are bought at a discount, the official said.
A first issue of two million lei of one-year bonds will be auctioned on December 3, he said.
"The maturity of other issues will be set later jointly with the National Bank, but it will not be longer than five years," the official said.
Both private persons and companies can buy the bonds and foreign investors can bid.
